gates.preflight: select artistic language, 2 visual references, scale baseline and one hero composition
gates.reject: inconsistent proportions, random scale, arbitrary primitive-looking finish

gates.preflight: select architectural closure plus camera occlusion strategy and separate camera/player collision
gates.firstArticle: single interior room with roof, doorway, corner, furniture; test 2 orientations
gates.reject: missing physical roof, camera passes through walls, blocked hero sightline
gates.repair: occlusion-aware roof/wall cutaway or camera mode transition

gates.preflight: define local forward axis, global up, root motion/speed mapping; specify justified backpedal/strafe
gates.firstArticle: start / turn / stop and obstacle route with foot contact
gates.reject: normal walking faces opposite actual velocity
gates.repair: correct rotation quaternion, animation axis, input mapping

gates.preflight: define physical anchor or justified suspension, affordance, action, reaction and camera framing
gates.reject: unexplained floating prop or action with no visible outcome
gates.repair: redesign prop relation, animation and responsive feedback

gates.preflight: define plan, scale, function, foreground/midground/background, land use and framing
gates.firstArticle: one coherent block/area with street and human scale
gates.reject: huge arbitrary cubes or isolated building in implausible placement
gates.repair: change block typology and layout generator before replication

gates.preflight: proportions and mechanical parts plus seating and circulation rules from lawful refs
gates.firstArticle: one seat bay, wheel/window/door relationships and vehicle exterior viewed at intended angle
gates.reject: mismatched seats, roof heights, windows or no context in road
gates.repair: correct vehicle skeleton and seat layout before repetition

gates.preflight: assign full-screen experience, universal shell, game-only minimal HUD and edit-only tools
gates.firstArticle: 320px portrait and landscape with menu closed/open, touching focal action
gates.reject: duplicate menus, admin-looking page, fixed overlay obscuring scene
gates.repair: remove nested shell, use global contextual menu

gates.preflight: choose licensed/original audio, monotonic audio timing, calibration and gesture grammar
gates.firstArticle: short sync demo with tap, hold start/end, trace/slide, judgement, feedback
gates.reject: visual only point tapping, notes drift from audio, missing hold/release, inconsistent sizes
gates.repair: redesign input and audio clock rather than adding decoration

gates.preflight: choose expressive silhouette, modeling/asset route, face/cloth/rig/material appropriate to view
gates.firstArticle: front/side/three-quarter and one action, author source editable
gates.reject: primitive humanoid final, blank face, recurrent generic body

promotion.mustShow: pre-build decision avoids previous class of failure
